tof.help: Time-of-flight geometry: the periodicity is cut across one box vector, carriers are injected in the source region and absorbed in the sink region at the opposite face

axis.help: Box vector across which the periodicity is cut; transport runs along the normal of the face spanned by the other two box vectors, from fractional coordinate 0 (source side) to 1 (sink side)

source.help: Source (injection) region; if thickness and pattern are both given, a segment must satisfy both

thickness.help: Thickness of the source slab at the face with fractional coordinate 0, measured along the normal (0: no slab criterion)

pattern.help: Segment type wildcard, e.g. 'Alq3*' (empty: no pattern criterion)

sink.help: Sink (absorbing) region; if thickness and pattern are both given, a segment must satisfy both

thickness.help: Thickness of the sink slab at the face with fractional coordinate 1, measured along the normal (0: no slab criterion)

pattern.help: Segment type wildcard (empty: no pattern criterion)

ignoretypes.help: Segment types (wildcards, separated by commas or spaces) that take no part in transport: no hops to or from them
